ruleDefinitions.name: Internet Explorer DisableFirstRunCustomize Enabled
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects changes to the Internet Explorer "DisableFirstRunCustomize" value, which prevents Internet Explorer from running the first run wizard the first time a user starts the browser after installing Internet Explorer or Windows.
 Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX("\\\\Microsoft\\\\Internet\\ Explorer\\\\Main\\\\DisableFirstRunCustomize$") AND (Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000001\)" OR Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000002\)")) AND  NOT ((process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\explorer\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\ie4uinit\.exe"))
